Supplementary Algorithm S1: G-F Curve Construction

Input:
  - Embedding coordinates for N nodes
  - GO annotation mapping for each node
  - Range of distance thresholds r = [0.05, 0.55] with step Δr
  - Community detection algorithm A (greedy modularity optimization)

Output:
  - G-F curves: purity(r), modularity(r)

Procedure:
1. Compute pairwise Euclidean distance matrix D (N × N)
2. For each r in r_range:
   a. Construct graph G(r) by adding edge (i,j) if D[i,j] < r and i ≠ j
   b. Apply greedy modularity optimization to G(r) to obtain communities
   c. Compute functional purity = mean over communities of (max GO term count / community size)
   d. Compute Newman-Girvan modularity Q(r)
3. Plot purity(r) and Q(r) against r
4. Return curves
